newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Industries started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - ITT Industries started.

text.p: -- Furman Selz said it initiated coverage of ITT Industries Inc as neutral.
-- Said company has potential to improve operating results through sales growth, cost reduction efforts and asset redeployment.
-- Said the first quarter will be challenging due to strong dollar and tough comparisons in the automotive sector.
-- Sees "essentially" flat first quarter results, with earnings improvement for the rest of the year.
-- ITT Industries, which was the manufacturing operation of ITT Corp until 1996, lost 1/8 to 26.
